title: Compatible homogeneous-fraction charts for arbitrary graded line maps
statement:
Let $f:W\to T$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $\mathcal A=\bigoplus_{d\geq0}\mathcal A_d$ a quasi-coherent graded commutative $\mathcal O_T$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-quasi-coherent-algebra, def-weil-pbc-graded-sheaf-structures], $L$ an invertible $\mathcal O_W$-module [def-sc-invertible-module], and $\psi:f^*\mathcal A\to\bigoplus_{d\geq0}L^{\otimes d}$ a graded algebra homomorphism, with tensor pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] and tensor powers [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Let $W_V=f^{-1}V$ for an affine open $V\subseteq T$, and let $A=\Gamma(V,\mathcal A)$. For $a\in A_d$, $d>0$, put $W_a=\{w\in W_V:\psi(a)_w\text{ freely generates }L_w^{\otimes d}\}$ [def-sc-section-generating-locus]. The union of these opens, over $V,d,a$, equals the union of the stalkwise surjectivity loci of the positive-degree maps $\psi_d$, $d>0$. Each $W_a$ has a unique morphism $q_{V,a}:W_a\to D_+(a)=\operatorname{Spec}A_{(a)}$ [def-pc-proj, def-nagata-homogeneous-localization-degree-zero] whose ring map is
$$b/a^m\longmapsto\psi(b)/\psi(a)^m,\qquad m\geq0,\quad b\in A_{md}.$$
Division means the unique coefficient relative to the free generator $\psi(a)^m$. After composition with the chart embedding into $\operatorname{Proj}_T(\mathcal A)$ [def-nagata-relative-proj], these morphisms agree on every pairwise intersection, including different positive degrees and different affine base opens. On a trivializing affine open $\operatorname{Spec}B\subseteq W_V$, write $\psi(a)=\alpha_a e^{\otimes d}$; then $W_a$ restricts to $D(\alpha_a)$ and the formula is $b/a^m\mapsto\alpha_b/\alpha_a^m$. These chart maps are unchanged by a new trivialization of $L$ and are compatible with open refinements on $W$ and on $T$.
